title: Massachusetts controlled-prescription required elements
rule_summary: A controlled-substance prescription must include the practitioner, patient, drug, strength, directions, date, registration, cautionary, and refill information required by Massachusetts law.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply required elements requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing required elements with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
